judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool paper (JOSS) for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS; it is not the Lee2021 Mobile BCI data descriptor.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/standard extension for organizing EEG data, used for this dataset's formatting; it does not describe the Mobile BCI ERP dataset.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
